title: Paneport title entry
description: One title of Paneport's compatibility database, a file in compat/titles/ (C-0008). docs/design/compat-db.md maps every field of C-0008 section 2 to its clause here.

schemaVersion.description: The version of this schema that the file follows (C-0008 section 2).

architecture.description: The architecture of the program that executable names.

launch.description: The launch path, derived from drm (C-0008 section 5). The conditions under allOf say when an entry may state it.

graphicsApi.description: The graphics APIs the title uses.

runtimes.description: The runtimes the title needs, from the fixed list in $defs/runtime.

memoryEstimateMiB.description: Expected peak memory that the game adds, in MiB: the process footprint during play minus the footprint just before the game's first process started.

jitPoolMiB.description: The JIT pool size in MiB. The JIT flow still applies the limit of C-0006 section 4 to the memory limit of the moment.

translator.description: Translator options. Only the keys listed under properties are allowed (C-0008 section 2); the list starts empty.

environment.description: Environment variables for the game. Only the names listed under properties are allowed (C-0008 section 2); the list starts empty. It never holds SteamAppId, SteamGameId, SteamAppPath or any other variable that steam_api or a DRM wrapper reads (C-0008 section 5).

prefix.description: Whether the title runs in the shared Wine prefix or in one of its own (C-0004 section 4).

rating.description: Computed from the reports, never edited by hand (C-0008 section 3).

allOf.$comment: C-0008 section 5: launch is direct only when steamApi and steamStub are false and ceg is no, here in the entry's own drm.
An entry states dock only when its own drm shows a value that blocks the Direct path, so the stated path is the one the app takes whatever the device's classification adds (docs/design/compat-db.md).
C-0008 section 5: a local title shows no Steam marker and is launched only on the Direct path. Its exeSha256 values hash the program that executable names (C-0008 section 2).
C-0008 section 4: gameBuild is the Steam build ID for a Steam title and the SHA-256 of the program file for a local title.

id.description: The title's identity. A Steam title has steamAppId and a local title exeSha256, never both. The file is named steam-<steamAppId>.json or local-<slug>.json (C-0008 section 1).

exeSha256.description: The SHA-256 of the program that executable names, one per known build.

slug.description: One or more groups of lowercase ASCII letters and digits joined by single hyphens (C-0008 section 1, docs/design/app-shell.md section 2).

sha256.description: A SHA-256 value in lowercase hexadecimal.

relativePath.description: A path relative to the install folder, with forward slashes: no leading or trailing slash, no empty, . or .. segment, no segment that ends in a dot or a space, which Windows trims, and none of the characters that Windows forbids in file names.

not.$comment: A segment that ends in a dot or a space, which also excludes . and ..

executable.description: The program the Direct path starts (C-0008 section 2).

workingDirectory.description: The working directory: . for the install folder itself, or a relative path.

text.description: A string without the NUL character, which would cut it short where the host passes it on as C text.

drm.description: The classification of C-0007 section 5. Absent means not yet classified, and so does each absent member, which the device's classification may fill in (C-0008 section 1). No member has a default, so nothing allows a launch by default.

runtime.description: The fixed list of runtime identifiers (C-0008 section 2).

renderScale.description: The internal resolution as a fraction of the output.

frameRateCap.$comment: It must divide the display's refresh rate, which only the running app knows, so the session checks that.

helperPolicy.description: Helper programs the session refuses to start, such as crash reporters. Never a program that performs a license or DRM check (C-0008 section 5).

device.description: The device model identifier, such as iPhone18,1.

iosVersion.description: The iOS version and build, such as 27.2 (24B119).

paneportVersion.description: A release tag (v and a Semantic Version, C-0009 section 6) or a full commit hash.

gameBuild.description: The Steam build ID, or for a local title the SHA-256 of the program file. The conditions under allOf check which.

evidence.description: The path of the evidence record (C-0012 section 4).

peakMemoryMiB.description: The peak memory footprint of the whole process.

thermalState.description: The highest thermal state seen, in iOS's terms.

targetDevices.description: The model identifiers of the target devices of C-0001 section 2, whose reports count for the rating (C-0008 section 3). docs/design/compat-db.md names each device.
